name: Pernicon
appearance: A one-inch grasshopper-like insect with gripping pincers at the rear of its abdomen.

habitats: Organic debris in Adzerak’s ruined corridor

Special attacks and weaknesses.name: Swarm attack
Special attacks and weaknesses.effectNote: Only the swarm attacks. The encounter lists one attack at THAC0 20. Each swarm hit deals 1d10 damage and drains 1 point of Constitution.

Special attacks and weaknesses.name: Constitution loss
Special attacks and weaknesses.effectNote: At Constitution 2 the victim falls unconscious. At 0 the victim dies. Lost Constitution returns at 1 point per day.

Encounters.name: Ruined corridor
Encounters.effectNote: While characters search or handle the rubbish in area 12, there is a cumulative 10% chance per turn of an encounter. Each such encounter has an equal chance of being ten Rot Grubs or fifty Pernicons.

notes: 50 appearing in this encounter. 1 HP and 15 XP per individual. Unreliable (4) morale. Nonintelligent (0). Neutral.
John Terra, Four from Cormyr (TSR, 1997), The Bibliophile, area 12, p. 16.

name: Rot Grub
appearance: A one-inch, maggot-like grub found in refuse.

habitats: Organic debris in Adzerak’s ruined corridor

Special attacks and weaknesses.name: Burrow into exposed flesh
Special attacks and weaknesses.effectNote: A grub has a percentage chance equal to the target’s base AC to burrow into exposed flesh. The encounter gives no THAC0 or standard attack or damage. If untreated, the grubs reach the heart and kill the victim in 1d3 turns.

Special attacks and weaknesses.name: Fire and cure disease
Special attacks and weaknesses.effectNote: Fire kills 2d10 grubs if applied before 1d6 rounds of burrowing. A cure disease spell kills all the grubs outright.

Encounters.name: Ruined corridor

notes: 10 appearing in this encounter. 1 HP and 15 XP per individual. Unsteady (5) morale. Nonintelligent (0). Neutral.
